dedupe_keys.name: akos test net open data broadband speed and quality measurements slovenia

description: AKOS Test Net is the Slovenian regulator's certified tool for measuring the speed and quality of fixed and wireless broadband connections, built on the open-source RTR NetTest system from Austria. Users run tests in a browser or in mobile and desktop apps, and results are shown in history, map and statistics views. The anonymised measurements are published as open data. The open data page offers the results of the last 48 hours and of the last 31 days as zipped CSV and as XLSX, older results by month as CSV and XLSX, and a documented API with the structure given in HTML and Swagger form, returning JSON. Times are in UTC, and measurements that look implausible are flagged. Coverage: Slovenia, mobile and fixed connections, with test locations where shared. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and a JSON API, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: tests are self-selected and depend on user devices and wifi; results are stated to be informative only; the monthly archive start was not checked. Simulation uses: measured speed and latency by operator and place for Slovenian service models, and a check on operator coverage claims. Related records: the RTR NetTest open data for Austria and the CTU NetTest open data for Czechia use the same system; the AKOS geoportal and eAnalitik give coverage and market data.
name: AKOS Test Net open data: broadband speed and quality measurements (Slovenia)
notes: Open data page read with curl on 2026-09-26 (akostest.net redirects to http). last_updated is inferred from the rolling 48-hour and 31-day files. The RTR basis is inferred from the page's RTR branding and file names.
